info.prompt: The game HUD as a living tattoo across the player's forearm—skeletal gold circuitry branches under skin that peels back to reveal glowing cyan muscle fibers where dice slots hover like embedded jewels, while a holographic magenta slipstream trails the arm's movement, casting light on a background of vaulted black stone etched with pulsating neural pathways, the scene watched by a floating cyber-skull whose jaw unhinges to display the current score in flickering amber numerals amidst a corona of glitching terminal text.
